Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None

Space: Roomy

Hirelings: 1

Order: Craft

A Laboratory contains storage space for alchemical supplies and workspaces for crafting various concoctions.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following options:

Craft: Alchemist’s Supplies. The facility’s hireling crafts anything that can be made with @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulAlchemists]{Alchemist's Supplies}, using the rules in the Player’s Handbook and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgTreasure00000.JournalEntryPage.8b89AU6dQR6bti27]{chapter 7} of this book.

Craft: Poison. You commission the facility’s hireling to craft a vial containing one application of a poison. The poison must be one of the following: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgBurntOthurFum]{Burnt Othur Fumes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgEssenceOfEthe]{Essence of Ether}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.equipment.Item.dmgTorpor0000000]{Torpor}. This work takes 7 days, and you must pay half the poison’s cost. See @UUID[Compendium.dnd-dungeon-masters-guide.content.JournalEntry.dmgDmsToolbox000.JournalEntryPage.UfAEdm3LbTzvQHC5]{Poison} for descriptions and costs of poisons.
